description: Use when the user asks which UK rules, markings or certificates a product imported from China needs: lists the UK regulatory regimes (UKCA, WEEE, PSTI, toy safety, food contact, REACH, packaging EPR and others) that apply to a type of product, with what to ask the supplier for. With no product_type, it lists the product types.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

product_type.description: A product type such as 'toys', 'electronics' or 'furniture' (Chinese also works).

name: find_uk_compliance
title: Find UK compliance requirements
